display_long_description:
Now you can turn your virtual world into reality.

OWO Skin & OWO Device required to fully experience this App.
The system is made up of the OWO Skin, OWO Device and My OWO App! 
The App is the connection between the OWO Device and the game, so you will need to have a kit to use it.

OWO is a completely wireless system that allows you to feel sensations in real-time while playing compatible video games. 
It is designed for single-player or multiplayer, online or offline use. It is compatible with all platforms, so you will be able to feel games on mobile, tablet, console, PC and VR. See compatible games on our website: https://owogame.com/games/

With My OWO, you will calibrate the sensations to your liking, creating a completely customized experience. In less than 5 minutes you will set your initial calibration values for the sensations. After that, you will be able to calibrate the sensations of each game. Your calibration is saved on the cloud so you can access and modify it at any time. Change the parameters of each sensation in every muscle. Increase or decrease the intensity by changing the parameters of the sensations.
Become one with your avatar and feel what they feel. A new and immersive experience that allows gamers to interact differently with the environment and make decisions that could completely change the course of the game.
More than seeing, more than hearing, #FeelTheGame with OWO.
